description: The quantum opposite of a spiral-envelope mode: the same disk, envelope, and frozen gate, read as a normalised quantum amplitude with the winding reversed (m, k) -> (-m, -k). Measured: the opposite is invisible in density, orthogonal in amplitude, opposite in angular momentum, and visible only by interference (azimuthal standing wave with 2|m| nodes; radial standing wave with 2n nodes for m = 0). Synthetic only; no claim about real atoms, real electromagnetism, or quantum mechanics. Standard library only.
title: spiral-quantum-opposite
